description: This file defines a client class for interacting with the Amazon Chime SDK Media Pipelines service within the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes method annotations for various API operations related to media pipelines, including creation, deletion, retrieval, listing, and updating media pipeline resources, as well as associated configurations and tasks.
